label: Subject
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) under active surveillance.

label: CancerCondition AtDiagnosis Reference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at diagnosis for which surveillance is applied.

label: StartDate
definition: Start date of the active surveillance period.

label: EndDate
definition: End date of the active surveillance period (if concluded).

label: Subject
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) affected by the cancer condition at first diagnosis.

label: HistologyBehaviour
definition: Histology and behaviour of the neoplasm at first diagnosis. Histology describes the tumour cell type (morphology), while behaviour indicates whether the tumour is malignant, benign, carcinoma in situ, or of uncertain/borderline malignancy. This information may be unavailable during early diagnostic workup (e.g., before biopsy results are final) but is expected to be present once the diagnostic workup is completed.

label: BodySite
definition: Primary anatomical site where the cancer condition was first detected.

label: TumourGradeSystem
definition: Classification system used to define tumour grade, describing how abnormal tumour cells and tissue appear under microscopic examination (e.g. Gleason for prostate cancer, FNCLCC for soft tissue sarcomas). The grading system provides an indication of the biological aggressiveness of the tumour.

label: TumourGradeValue
definition: Grade value assigned according to the selected TumourGradeSystem. The grade reflects the degree of cellular differentiation and biological aggressiveness of the tumour and may evolve over time.

label: VisitDate
definition: Date of the clinical visit that established the diagnosis (one of the diagnosis dates).

label: BiopsyDate
definition: Date of the biopsy supporting the diagnosis (one of the diagnosis dates).

label: ImagingDate
definition: Date of the diagnostic imaging supporting the diagnosis (one of the diagnosis dates).

label: LabReportDate
definition: Date of the laboratory report supporting the diagnosis, including biomarkers when applicable.

label: BirthDate
definition: Patient date of birth (at least the year should be available).

label: SexAtBirth
definition: Biological sex assigned at birth, determined by sex characteristics observed at birth or infancy (e.g., genital characteristics and/or chromosome composition). This represents sex as a biological variable and should not be used to represent gender identity or administrative gender.

label: ObservedSex Gender
definition: Recorded sex at the time of cancer diagnosis, if different from SexAtBirth. This captures what is documented at diagnosis and should be interpreted in line with the clinical record context.

label: ComorbiditiesAtCancerDiagnosis
definition: Active chronic conditions present at the time of cancer diagnosis.

label: CancerCondition AtDiagnosis Reference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at first diagnosis for which the stage is reported.

label: ClassificationType
definition: Staging classification system used when the staging system needs to be explicitly identified (e.g. TNM).

label: StageValue
definition: One or more staging values expressed as (code, value) pairs.

label: Stage element code
definition: Identifies which staging element is being reported (e.g. T category, N category, M category, stage group).

label: Stage element value
definition: Value associated with the reported staging element (e.g. T2, N1, M0; or a stage group value).

label: Type
definition: It indicates whether the stage instance is of type Clinical or Pathological.

label: EvidenceReference
definition: Reference(s) to the evidence used to define the stage: imaging in case of a Clinical stage, or surgery in case of a Pathological stage.

label: CancerConditionReference
definition: Reference to the original cancer condition at diagnosis to which this progression refers.

label: DiseaseStatus
definition: Disease status at this time point (e.g. progression, stable disease, remission, recurrence).

label: TumourGradeSystem
definition: Classification system used to define tumour grade, describing how abnormal tumour cells and tissue appear under microscopic examination (e.g. Gleason for prostate cancer, FNCLCC for soft tissue sarcomas). The grading system provides an indication of the biological aggressiveness of the tumour.

label: TumourGradeValue
definition: Grade value assigned according to the selected TumourGradeSystem. The grade reflects the degree of cellular differentiation and biological aggressiveness of the tumour and may evolve over time.

label: AssertedDate
definition: Date when this progression/status was asserted/recorded.

label: ExtentType
definition: Extent of disease at this time point (Local, Loco-regional, Metastatic).

label: LocoRegionalSites
definition: Sites involved when ExtentType is Loco-regional.

label: MetastaticSites
definition: Sites involved when ExtentType is Metastatic.

label: Type
definition: Type of imaging procedure performed (e.g. thoracic MRI).

label: BodySite
definition: Anatomical site(s) on which the imaging procedure was performed.

label: Patient Reference
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) for whom follow-up information is recorded.

label: VitalStatus
definition: Patient vital status at the time of follow-up (Alive or Dead).

label: EvidenceOfDisease
definition: If Alive, indicates whether there is evidence of disease at follow-up.

label: CauseOfDeath
definition: If Dead, cause of death.

label: Date
definition: Date of the follow-up assessment.

label: DeathDate
definition: If Dead, the date of death.

label: CancerConditionAtDiagnosisReference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at diagnosis for which overall response is assessed.

label: ClinicalCancerProgressionReference
definition: Reference to the clinical progression time point, if response is assessed during progression.

label: TreatmentResponseType
definition: Overall response category (e.g. progression, stable disease, partial/complete remission).

label: Date
definition: Date of the response assessment.

label: Subject
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) receiving radiotherapy.

label: CancerCondition AtDiagnosis Reference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at diagnosis targeted by radiotherapy.

label: ClinicalCancerProgresionReference
definition: Reference to the clinical progression event, if radiotherapy is delivered in response to progression.

label: Intent
definition: Radiotherapy intent (Definitive/curative vs Palliative).

label: StartDate
definition: Start date of the radiotherapy course.

label: EndDate
definition: End date of the radiotherapy course (may be missing while ongoing).

label: BodySite
definition: Anatomical site(s) targeted by radiotherapy.

label: Setting
definition: Strategic timing/setting of radiotherapy (e.g. neoadjuvant, adjuvant, concomitant, alone).

label: Subject
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) undergoing the surgery.

label: CancerCondition AtDiagnosis Reference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at diagnosis targeted by the surgery.

label: ClinicalCancerProgressionReference
definition: Reference to the clinical progression event, if surgery is performed in response to progression.

label: Intent
definition: Surgical intent (Definitive/curative vs Palliative).

label: Date
definition: Date when the surgical procedure was performed.

label: BodySite
definition: Anatomical site(s) where the surgery was performed.

label: Subject
definition: Reference to the patient (subject) receiving systemic treatment.

label: CancerConditionAtDiagnosisReference
definition: Reference to the cancer condition at diagnosis targeted by systemic treatment.

label: ClinicalCancerProgresionReference
definition: Reference to the clinical progression event, if treatment is delivered in response to progression.

label: Intent
definition: Treatment intent (Definitive/curative vs Palliative).

label: Type
definition: Category of systemic treatment (e.g. chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, hormonal therapy).

label: StartDate
definition: Start date of the systemic treatment course.

label: EndDate
definition: End date of the systemic treatment course (may be missing while ongoing).

label: Ongoing
definition: Indicates that the treatment is ongoing when EndDate is not available.

label: Setting
definition: Strategic timing/setting of systemic treatment (e.g. neoadjuvant, adjuvant, concomitant, alone).
